opening.argument: The video solicits FTX participation through a referral arrangement: signups receive a stated 5% trading-fee discount, referrers receive 30% of referred users’ fees, and viewers are asked to distribute the link. It carries that solicitation into instructions to create and verify an account, deposit funds, and use highly leveraged futures, describing a potential $400,000 position from approximately $20,000 of collateral. It also promotes leveraged tokens and an FTT launch, illustrating a hypothetical $1,500 return from a $5,000 3x position and explicitly inviting participation. Together, those financial incentives, amplified-return examples, and instructions support the finding of a scam solicitation centered on token purchases and appreciation. The speaker does disclose liquidation risk and that longer-term leveraged-token results may differ. Those qualifications temper the pitch, while the supplied records establish no completed viewer deposits or trades, rewards received, or losses experienced.
